svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three strips of 610 mm flashing, 1,260 mm long, lapped 25 mm and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: riveted into one sheet; cut a 1,260 mm disc.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Snip the edge every 50 mm, 25 mm deep, and turn it down 90 degrees

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to make the skirt (1,210 mm inside).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes (cap layout picture): 180 mm in the centre for the outlet; six

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 46 mm on a 235 mm radius at 30, 90 ... degrees for the inlet legs;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm at 120 degrees, 430 mm out, under the junction box; 25 mm at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 95 degrees, 330 mm out, for the thermocouple exit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit grommets in the 40 and 25 mm holes; foil tape round the legs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: it lowers over the six inlet legs and the outlet and rests on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top insulation; eight screws through the skirt into the side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: every hole lines up with its pipe before it is pressed down.
